trailhead.label: Cristauta car park, above Santa Cristina, the board’s start

cautions: Steady climb of about 450 m on natural paths.
Early in the season some stretches may still hold snow.
Open grassy ridge near the summit cross: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
